question: Can a bounded real Minimalist+Falsifier structural program generator, using actual sampled feedback and an intervention budget, beat strongest fully comparable exact Bayesian EIG on new compositional Boolean worlds after one targeted development correction?
hypothesis: IPFC_B, with family-weighted balanced falsification, reduces disjoint development Brier by >=5% relative to strongest EIG (uniform and trained prior), random and fixed controls, no more than .02 absolute accuracy loss, no more probes. If not, stop this concrete algorithm rather than tune further.

predecessor_evidence.note: YNCA06 Stage0 found disagreement-only probes equal EIG on independent bits; two-pass tuning permitted by operator
CKAD22 native integrated development, remains independent and unmodified

inputs.name: Four-input Boolean compositional circuits from deterministic explicit grammar: atom,not,and,or,xor,majority,xor3,mux,xor4; 59 truth-unique programs

frozen_design.status: A exploratory development already consumed before this GitHub prereg. Pass B new development cohort not consumed; source must be committed, hashed and pinned before B first use.

seeds.train: 160001..160064 64 generated worlds for EIG_TRAINED prior only
seeds.future_reserved: 181001..181256 untouched, do not inspect unless B passes and separate prospective first-use protocol approved

frozen_design.worlds: Ground truth sampled deterministically from 33 higher-composition majority/mux/xor3/xor4 programs. Same fixed source grammar of 59 unique truth tables shared by all policies; two passive diagonal observations (actions 0,15); four active probes with fixed cost .02/action, 16-input final Brier and exact program accuracy.
frozen_design.methods: IPFC_A minimal consistent program + synthesized contradictory program per action; real action-outcome feedback updates competing family preference. IPFC_B one targeted correction to balance survivor split 4p(1-p) and retain small learned family preference. Fully matched uniform EIG, 64-train-world Dirichlet-smoothed EIG_TRAINED, random and fixed probe comparators.
frozen_design.source_stage: Pass B source/fixed controls pinned here BEFORE first inspection of B. Pass A exploratory already consumed. Future reserved untouched.
frozen_design.data_budget: 128 B worlds; four actively observed probes per world; same information/actions/all controls; no offline oracle labels exposed at policy inference, only evaluation.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python 3.12 stdlib, <60s per platform, no paid API, no owner model calls, no GPU
frozen_design.capacity: 59 deduplicated programs; fixed four probes; family reliability weights min 0.5 max 3.0, 0.25 increment and 0.10 decrement on real observations; IPFC_B adjustment adds split-balance score with factor 4 and 0.03 family preference.
frozen_design.evaluator: Mean Brier loss of posterior uniform survivor predictions over 16 input actions, plus mean exact-grammar classification, mean correct bits, active probe count and cost. B verdict independent of any A tuner changes.

controls: Exact EIG uniform prior over same grammar and observed actions
Exact EIG with trained Dirichlet-smoothed prior over 64 disjoint train worlds
Uniform seeded random probing on same per-world budget
Unadjusted IPFC_A as ablation, same B worlds

classification_rules.supported: Development candidate only if >=5% lower mean Brier versus best of trained EIG, uniform EIG, fixed and random on the disjoint B cohort, within 0.02 absolute prediction accuracy, <= baseline probes. Does not imply SCIENTIFIC_PASS or native integration.
classification_rules.mixed: Corrected B improves A but not strongest matched controls. Mark NO_GO for this concrete algorithm, while retaining meaningful mechanistic diagnostic.
classification_rules.negative: B does not improve best baseline or fails gain/accuracy/efficiency; stop tuning this algorithm after B, pivot rather than invent third pass on same distributions.
classification_rules.invalid: B result seen before source commit/hash lock, mismatch, modified thresholds, lost source audit, missing comparator, or actual model owner first-use beyond authority

prohibited_after_primary_run: retune B using B seed results
try additional candidate family weights on B
inspect reserved FRESH cohort on negative outcome
overstate toy program synthesis as native Yggdrasil general intelligence
merge negative prototype to accepted model
preregistration_note: Operator clarifies bounded tuning is allowed; no strict zero-tuning rule. Pass A exploratory and repeatable; B is one fixed mechanistic correction with independent development evidence; no SCIENTIFIC_PASS claims.
